scams.name: The Sirmione Tourist-Trap Markup (€75 Lunch, €8 Gelato)
scams.description: Lake-facing restaurants and gelaterias on the Sirmione peninsula price at extreme tourist markups. A June 3, 2025 Corriere Brescia cronaca piece 'Una giornata a Sirmione tra code, bellezza e... salassi' documents €75 for a single lunch and €8 for one gelato scoop. A viral 2025 Instagram reel shows a visitor quoted '3.50 per scoop' with escalating upcharges. A May 2025 traveler-forum 'Ultra-overtourism — Extreme Edition' thread describes ~14 million annual visitors funneled through a narrow peninsula as 'a congested trap' with spintoni and code interminabili, and Il Giorno's 'Sirmione invasa dai turisti' confirms the pattern.
scams.avoidance: Walk at least 300 meters inland from the castle or back toward the drawbridge before eating — Corriere frames peninsula-center prices as salassi (bloodlettings), not normal Italian prices. Confirm single-scoop and double-scoop gelato prices at the counter before ordering. Photograph the posted menu outside (required by Italian law) before sitting; ask the server to weigh fish before cooking. Prefer Desenzano, Peschiera, or Lazise. Always demand a ricevuta fiscale.
scams.location: Sirmione peninsula — Piazza Castello, Via Vittorio Emanuele II, the alleys around Rocca Scaligera, the walk to Grotte di Catullo

scams.name: The Fake "Private Boat Tour" Facebook Deposit Scam
scams.description: 'Local captain' scammers pitch private Lake Garda boat tours via Facebook Lake Garda groups, Instagram DMs, and direct waterfront approaches, then collect an off-platform deposit (bank wire, PayPal friends-and-family, Revolut) and vanish. The Lake Garda Italy Facebook group has published repeated near-identical fraud alerts since 2023 — one 2023 alert posted across multiple groups naming 'Private boat tour scam in Lake Garda' as a running thread. Navigazione Laghi (NLG) at navigazionelaghi.it is the only official state-sanctioned public-line ferry operator; legitimate private charters all publish a P.IVA.
scams.avoidance: Use only platforms with refund guarantees — GetYourGuide, Viator, Airbnb Experiences — or book direct through Navigazione Laghi for public ferries. For private charters, verify the captain's P.IVA on verifica-partita-iva.it before paying any deposit. Refuse any 'pay off-platform to avoid fees' request — that exact phrasing is the clearest scam tell. Cross-check against the Lake Garda Italy Facebook group running list of flagged pages. Pay by credit card through the platform only.
scams.location: Facebook Lake Garda groups, Instagram DMs, and waterfront approaches at Sirmione, Desenzano, Bardolino, and Garda

scams.name: The Bardolino/Garda Fake Deaf-Mute Petition Pickpocket
scams.description: Organized crews on the Veronese lungolago approach tourists with clipboards and 'I am deaf-mute' petitions for 'children with disabilities,' guiding victims' hands to sign while an accomplice pickpockets. L'Arena documents Polizia locale di Bardolino intercepting three of four falsi sordomuti during a coordinated sweep (with one officer injured); a separate L'Arena Garda-Baldo piece — 'Nicotra, un giorno da sceriffo' — documents the sindaco personally stopping two fake deaf-mutes. Gardapost reports Carabinieri di Lazise charging two travelling arrotini with truffa and danneggiamento in a related scam.
scams.avoidance: Do not sign any clipboard petition on a Lake Garda lungolago — refuse with 'no, grazie' and keep walking. Keep phone and wallet out of back pockets and outer bag pouches on the Bardolino or Garda lungolago. If seated at a café and approached, keep one hand on your bag and step back from physical contact. If robbed, call 112 and report to Polizia locale di Bardolino, Garda, or Carabinieri di Lazise. Daily-use wallet €40–€60 only; flat pouch under your shirt for cards and passport.
scams.location: Lungolago di Bardolino, Piazza del Porto (Garda town), Lungolago Regina Adelaide, Peschiera del Garda, Sirmione bridge pedestrian zones

scams.name: The Grotte di Catullo "Combo Tour" Ticket Markup
scams.description: Touts at the Sirmione drawbridge and castle arch sell 'skip-the-line combo tours' bundling the Grotte di Catullo with the Scaligero castle, a peninsula train, and/or an NLG ferry at €20–€45 per person. The real on-site adult Grotte ticket is €6 intero / €3 ridotto (TripAdvisor 2024–2025 reviews and beniculturali.it confirm), bought at Piazzale Orti Manara 4, 25019 Sirmione (BS), +39 030 916157. A January 2025 Gardapost piece documents free guided tour days included with the €6 ticket — meaning there is never a real 'skip-the-line' value to sell.
scams.avoidance: Buy Grotte di Catullo tickets only at the on-site box office (Piazzale Orti Manara 4) or via the official beniculturali.it booking portal — never from a tout. Walk from the Sirmione drawbridge to the Grotte in 20–25 minutes along the signed peninsula path. For guided tours, book a licensed Regione Lombardia guide (tessera di guida turistica). Most of the peninsula is free to walk without any ticket; Spiaggia Giamaica and the external ruins view cost zero.
scams.location: Sirmione peninsula — Piazza Castello, drawbridge, walk to Piazzale Orti Manara 4, and 'Sirmione Express' tourist train loop

scams.name: The Malcesine Funivia Queue-Jump & Repeat-Ticket Hustle
scams.description: Unofficial resellers on Via Navene Vecchia and the Malcesine lungolago sell 'skip-the-line' Funivia Malcesine Monte Baldo cable car tickets at €35–€40 (above the Funivie del Baldo lower-station rate) that turn out to be ordinary or invalidated tickets, plus 'guided Monte Baldo hike' bundles that mark up the signposted free Monte Altissimo trail by €50–€80. TripAdvisor's 'Warning Mount Baldo Wait Times!' Lake Garda Forum thread documents legitimate mid-season mid-morning waits of 3+ hours with no time-warnings posted at queue entry — enabling the hustle.
scams.avoidance: Buy cable car tickets only at the Funivia Malcesine lower-station office or online at funiviedelbaldo.it. Arrive at 08:00 opening to avoid the 3-hour mid-morning waits TripAdvisor users document. Check the timetables and fares page before travelling (30-minute cadence is conditional). Do not pay for a 'guided Monte Baldo hike' — the Monte Altissimo trail is signposted and free. In peak summer, buy a dated time-slot ticket online in advance so resellers have nothing to sell you.
scams.location: Funivia Malcesine Monte Baldo lower station (Via Navene Vecchia, Malcesine) and surrounding lungolago

scams.name: The Lake Garda Holiday Rental Deposit Scam
scams.description: Peak-summer 'villa with lake view' listings on Facebook Marketplace, Instagram, and off-platform Airbnb/Booking messages demand wire-transfer deposits, then disappear. A 2023 Lake Garda Italy Facebook group post documents a family's full deposit lost after 'booking directly with accommodation provider.' A 2025 traveler-forum Sirmione overtourism thread identifies short-term rentals as 'the cancer of Lake Garda,' confirming the listings ecosystem has grown to a scale where fake listings hide among real ones. The Airbnb Community 'Long term rental safety concern' thread documents the off-platform wire variant.
scams.avoidance: Book only through Airbnb, Booking.com, Hotels.com, or Vrbo — all have pay-through-platform guarantees. Refuse any off-platform payment request, full stop — even from a 5-star host. Verify the property on Google Street View, Instagram geo-tags, and TripAdvisor photos before paying. Pay by credit card (not debit). Budget for Lombardia/Veneto tourism tax (€1–€4 per person per night); demand a ricevuta fiscale for any cash city-fee or pay by card only.
scams.location: Facebook Marketplace, Instagram, and off-platform DMs for listings in Sirmione, Desenzano, Peschiera, Bardolino, Garda, Malcesine, Limone, Riva

scams.name: The Verona Airport → Garda Unlicensed NCC Overcharge
scams.description: Unlicensed NCC drivers approach arrivals at Verona Villafranca 'Valerio Catullo' airport (VRN) with 'taxi?' offers, quoting flat rates of €90–€120 for rides that metered official Radio Taxi Verona (white-painted, 045.532.222) deliver at roughly €50–€60 to Bardolino, Lazise, or Peschiera. Variants include 'broken credit-card reader' ATM scams and 'deviazione' fake detours. A BresciaToday piece — 'Vestone: attenti alla truffa dei finti turisti rimasti senza benzina' — documents a Lake Garda variant where foreigners ran a fake stranded-tourist pitch.
scams.avoidance: Use only white-painted Radio Taxi Verona (045.532.222) vehicles at the signed rank outside the terminal — confirm the metered ride before closing the door. Cheaper alternative: ATV Aerobus service 199 to Verona Porta Nuova (€6), then regional train to Peschiera/Desenzano/Lazise (€3–€5). Pre-book through GetYourGuide, Welcome Pickups, or a hotel shuttle with posted rate. Demand a ricevuta fiscale. Refuse any ATM detour; complain to the Polizia di Stato VRN airport office.
scams.location: Verona Villafranca 'Valerio Catullo' airport (VRN) arrivals hall and taxi forecourt; Verona Porta Nuova taxi rank for onward transfers
